title: location signal
description: Observer location. GET /api/signals/location, polled every 60 s. From providers.location: 'fixed' (config, the default), 'corelocation' (an external CLI) or 'ip' (ipinfo.io, opt-in: sends the public IP). Re-resolved every 30 min (daily when fixed). null very early at start-up. SENSITIVE.

name.description: Display name, upper case by convention ('GREENWICH · LONDON').
